# R5.33 size-trigger review — 2026-11-03

Scoped fresh-context adjudication of the R5.33 ≤600 trigger (worker checkpoint `de806d2e` on `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.33`, base `0550e6f5`).

## Verdict: AMEND

- **Measured:** 1,425 changed source/test lines (numstat: approval.rs +70/−1, approval/tests.rs +7, ops.rs +191, tests/r5_33.rs +1,157) vs ≤600 (~2.4×). ~81% of the bulk is the battery — same profile as R5.32's 62%.
- **No documented seam:** the crate seam (monitor authority vs env cells) is a real boundary but not an admitted split seam. L150's four weak seams are all consumed or other tickets' boundaries; the O2 partition packet binds the unit to one owner working set and writes contingencies verbatim where intended (X7/E-207/F-005 carry them; O2 carries none). Decomposition row 203 is one owner row.
- **The monitor fold fix is the apparatus's own precondition, not a separable leg:** the durable row has written `request.options` since ADR-0343 D4 but the fold dropped them (`options: Vec::new()`); §5.2 and D3 O4 are definitional ("reject unoffered answer"). The env `UnofferedAdmitted`/`UnauthorizedAdmitted` cell members cannot evidence anything without the gate. Same class as R5.24's R0 fold repair and R5.28's K-2 fix.
- **Leg (b) alone does not de-trigger:** ops.rs 191 + r5_33.rs 1,157 ≈ 1,348 vs ≤600 — the cut removes only ~77 lines (R5.13/R5.8 non-curative pattern), and unlike R5.15/R5.16 leg (a) there is no self-exercising contract module at a written seam.
- **Impl-vs-battery rejected:** leg (a) would land a semantic tightening of the shared respond contract verified only by a 7-line fixture adjustment — an unverified authority change whose entire evidence matrix lives in leg (b). AC-1/AC-2 span the cut.
- **Magnitude in band:** ~2.4× inside the accepted envelope (1.08×–3.0×).
